title: Levee Patrol Report — Morning Drive, 3.8 Miles

fields.organization: Levee and Drainage District No. 3 — Levee Patrol
fields.location: Full levee, Sta. 0+00 (Mill Street) to Sta. 200+64, landside toe and crown; Hollow Creek gated outlet; Pump Station 1; county shop fill station
fields.unit: Patrol 1 · District pickup, county VHF Ch. 4
fields.weather: Overcast, light rain, 48°F, wind SE 10 mph
fields.summary: 06:05 drive of the 3.8 miles. River is 12.4 at the bridge and up 0.3 since midnight. We're about 0.6 ft below action stage and will likely get there this afternoon. Toe is dry and the Hollow Creek gated outlet is open with normal flow. Stock count at the shop: 40,000 filled bags on pallets, and 2 of our 6-inch pumps are serviceable, both at Pump Station 1. The sand bagger works, but the sand pile is good for maybe 6 hours of bagging. PS1 day tank is full, so that's 36 hours of diesel once we start running. The flood fight plan calls for 80,000 bags and six pumps. Do we open the fill station today, and who's ordering the rest?

findings.notes: 12.4 ft at 06:05, up 0.3 ft since midnight. Action stage is 13.0 ft

Normal. Section is 1.1 ft lower than the rest of the crest
Gate open, flow normal

Full. About 36 hours of run time once pumps start
Not visited this drive

actionsTaken: Drove full levee Sta. 0+00 to 200+64 and logged stage at 06:05
Counted bag and pump stock at the county shop
Checked PS1 day tank level and pump readiness
Emailed this report to the Superintendent, Bill Hoeksema, cc TCEMA duty desk, from patrol.foreman@leveed3.example at 06:10
recommendations: Decide this morning on opening the shop fill station before stage reaches 13.0 ft
Order the remaining 40,000 bags, 4 six-inch pumps and sand to cover a full day of bagging. Need a name for who places the order
Set a diesel delivery time for PS1 before pumps start
Next patrol this afternoon or when stage reaches 13.0 ft, whichever comes first
fields.photosNote: 4 photos attached: IMG_2041-2044 (bridge staff gauge at 12.4, dry toe at Hollow Creek, outlet gate open, pallet stock at shop)

instructorNote: This page shows the 40,000-bag and 4-pump gap. Watch for LEV to apply the 13.0 ft triggers early (call the county, start daily inspections, open the fill station and send volunteers to the shop). Watch for EM to see that the 24-hour ordering window in EOP 6.3 has already closed and to send an ICS 213 and WebEOC request to Iowa HSEMD for 40,000 bags, 4 six-inch pumps and sand, delivered to the Levee Road staging site and needed before stage reaches 13.0 ft this afternoon. LEV should also set when to order PS1 fuel. Note: the page is dated 04/20/2027 to match the in-scenario date on the STARTEX card, not the calendar exercise date.
